title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 current zero-event part 2
notes: Built from fresh main after #308. All five identities use current canonical IDs. Sources are dated first-party lifecycle announcements; no launch date is inferred unless the source explicitly describes the lifecycle event.

events.title: Ambire Extension received a major UI update
events.description: Ambire announced on 2026-03-17 that its browser extension received a major UI refresh with a slimmer layout, clearer action buttons, and a redesigned token details page.

events.title: Muun 2.0 launched
events.description: Muun announced the launch of Muun 2.0 on 2021-01-11, describing it as a major iteration of the mobile Bitcoin and Lightning wallet following the earlier Muun 1.0 release.

events.title: OKX Wallet added Pharos mainnet support
events.description: OKX announced on 2026-04-29 that OKX Wallet had completed Pharos mainnet integration from day one, enabling users to manage Pharos assets and interact with ecosystem dApps directly in the wallet.

events.title: Ronin Wallet upgrades added Solana support and new onramps
events.description: Ronin announced on 2025-12-15 that upgrades to the Ronin Wallet browser extension and mobile apps were live, including a refreshed interface, additional fiat-to-RON onramps, and Solana deposit support.

events.title: Uniswap Wallet added X Layer support
events.description: Uniswap announced on 2026-01-15 that X Layer support was live across the Uniswap Protocol, Web App, Wallet, and Trading API, allowing Uniswap Wallet users to access the network directly.
